title: Rav Acha son of Rav Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 101a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.101a.5), raising an objection to Rav Ashi; but Hyman says the reading should be “son of Rava,” as in Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Acha son of Rav Acha raising the objection about fish passing through a boat’s partitions. Hyman proposes “son of Rava” on the authority of Dikdukei Soferim.
